description: ImpAI's handicap exemption (tagpu/ddraw/src/tagpu_impai.c; engine/sim.md, Difficulty and the AI handicap): an idle human seat and two CORE computer seats on Town & Country at Easy, seat 1 OTA AI and seat 2 ImpAI, so the launch writes `seatai=2` into the store. Both seats are the same side, so their commanders produce the same terms: at Easy OTA AI's income is half of ImpAI's. The `impai-handicap` test group and tools/impai/handicap_check.py load it; both apply impai-handicap-economy.json, and the group impai-handicap-army.json too.
